items.text: AN ALARM IS SOUNDING.
items.direction: Urgent dramatic fantasy narration with clear danger and action

items.text: AN ALARM STARTS RINGING!
items.direction: Urgent dramatic fantasy narration with clear danger and action

items.text: DO YOU TAKE IT?
items.direction: Clear measured fantasy narration ending with a direct question

items.text: 'THAT'S THEM! GET THEM!'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: 'BLASPHEMERS! GET THEM!'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: WHAT ARE YOU DOING HERE?
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: 'WELL BOYS, I THINK WE HAVE THE INTRUDERS HERE. GET THEM!'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: 'ALL RIGHT, THEN. WHAT IS TODAY'S PASSWORD?'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: WITH A NOD OF THE HEAD YOU ARE LEFT ALONE.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: 'WHAT? I THINK YOU SCUM ARE IMPOSTERS!'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: YOU CONFRONT AN ARMED MAN WHO IMMEDIATELY ATTACKS YOU.
items.direction: Urgent dramatic fantasy narration with clear danger and action

items.text: THE DOOR OF THE BUILDING YOU ARE PASSING SLAMS.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: A FIGHTER EMERGES FROM THE BUILDING NEARBY AND CONFRONTS YOU.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: 'WHAT ARE YOU DOING HERE?', HE REPEATS.
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: HE LUNGES FOR THE DOOR AND HITS A BUTTON. THEN HE TURNS AND FACES THE PARTY WITH SWORD DRAWN. 'IN A MOMENT A PATROL WILL BE HERE. IF YOU STAY TO FIGHT ME YOU WILL DIE.'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: AS YOU START TO ATTACK HIM, FOUR GIANTS BURST OUT OF A NEARBY BUILDING.
items.direction: Urgent dramatic fantasy narration with clear danger and action

items.text: A PATROL ROUNDS THE CORNER..
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: HE QUICKLY RETREATS THROUGH THE DOOR AND SLAMS IT, YELLING, 'INTRUDERS!'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: A GROUP OF FOUR GIANTS CHARGE OUT OF A NEARBY BUILDING.
items.direction: Urgent dramatic fantasy narration with clear danger and action

items.text: 'WHAT YA DOIN' HERE?'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: 'SORRY, SIR. YEAH, WE CAN GET YA TO THE BOSS. THIS PAPER HAS THE PASSWORDS.'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: 'WE DO SO KNOW THE PASSWORDS! YOU ALWAYS THINK YOU'RE SO SMART. LET'S SEE IF YOU CAN READ TODAY'S LIST.'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: TODAY'S PASSWORD IS
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: THE GATE PASSWORD IS
items.direction: Clear measured fantasy narration ending with a direct question

items.text: 'GET LOST, WIMP! IF YA DON'T BEAT IT WE'LL BEAT YOU! HA! HA!' THE GIANT LEADER POKES THE GIANT NEXT TO HIM, 'BEAT IT, BEAT THEM! GET IT?!'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: 'GO AHEAD THREATEN US! TEAR OUT OUR HEARTS! CUT OFF OUR HEADS! SLICE OPEN OUR BELLIES... IF YOU CAN.
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: 'HEY LOOK! IT MUST BE THEM INTRUDERS.'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: ON THE GROUND YOU FIND A PEACE OF PAPER THAT SAYS:
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: YOU HAVE ENTERED AN ARMORY. INSIDE IS A LARGE ASSORTMENT OF ARMOR AND WEAPONS.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: DO YOU WANT TO TAKE ANYTHING?
items.direction: Clear measured fantasy narration ending with a direct question

items.text: YOU ENTER A ROOM THAT REEKS OF SMOKE AND BURNED FOOD. YOU SEE THREE HUMAN SLAVES COOKING MEAT, PEELING POTATOES, AND BEING BEATEN BY VISCIOUS LOOKING GNOLL.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: THE GNOLL TURNS TO FLEE. AS HE RUNS BY, ONE OF THE SLAVES TRIPS HIM. YOU ADVANCE AND CUT THE OVERSEER'S THROAT.
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: YOU LOOK AT THE WRITING...
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: 'IT IS TODAY'S PASSWORD AT THE MAIN GATE INTO THE HEDGE MAZE. ALAS, I CAN NOT HELP YOU WITH THAT FOR I HAVE NOT BEEN INSIDE. BUT I HAVE HEARD THE MAZE IS DEADLY!'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: THE OVERSEER TURNS TOWARD YOU BLUDGEON IN HAND. 'GO ON! GET OUT OF MY KITCHEN OR I'LL THROW BOILING OIL ON YOU!'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: 'I SAID GET OUT!' THE GNOLL GRABS A POT FROM THE FIRE AND THROWS ITS CONTENTS AT YOU.
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: YOU ENTER A BRIGHTLY LIT BUILDING WHICH REEKS OF TALLOW AND LEATHER. YOU SEE SIX SCRIBES BUSILY WRITING DOWN THE REPORTS OF A COUPLE OF OFFICERS.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: WHAT ARE YOU DOING HERE?
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: THE SIX SCRIBES DIVE FOR COVER AS THE TWO OFFICERS ATTACK.
items.direction: Urgent dramatic fantasy narration with clear danger and action

items.text: YOU ENTER A BUILDING WHICH IS FILLED WITH TABLES AND WRITING SUPPLIES. THOUGH EMPTY, THERE ARE SIGNS THAT WORK HAS BEEN DONE HERE RECENTLY.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene
